name: Optimal 360 | 3D Scanner & Viewer
author: Optimal 360

sections.description:
Optimal 360° 3D Scanner & 3D Viewer for WordPress & WooCommerce

Showcase your products with interactive photorealistic 3D views and smooth 360° spins directly inside WordPress. No 3D modeling skills are required, just use your phone camera. Simply upload a short video circling your product, and the plugin generates a responsive, mobile-optimized 3D model hologram and viewer that works on any landing page, product page, or post.

Learn Mode | Demo

Android App | iPhone App | Web Sign Up

Increase Engagement & Boost Sales

Give visitors the ability to rotate, zoom, and explore your products from every angle. 3D product photography and 360 views create a more engaging, interactive experience that builds trust and keeps people on your site longer. Perfect for marketers, product photographers, designers, and businesses looking to make their WordPress pages stand out.

Professional Editing Features

Advanced editing features include professional color correction, camera controls, and more. The AI enhanced workflow takes about 15 minutes from camera to screen.

  • Realistic 3D Viewer (3D Photography Light Field Based Model)
  • Mobile Optimized 360 Viewer
  • Advanced Professional Editing Features
  • Supports WordPress Block Editor (Gutenberg).
  • Supports WooCommerce Products
  • Supports Elementor and Divi Editors. Plus Shortcodes.
  • AI Enhanced Workflow Takes 15 Minutes
  • Free Scans Available

External services

This plugin connects to an external API to obtain 360 showcase information. The user can login to the service to connect showcase data to the plugin.

This service is provided by “Optimal 360” with the following terms and policies:

Privacy policy: https://optml360.com/privacy-policy-en-us
Domains: https://embed.optml360.com, https://app.optml360.com
